subject: Master PM directive: ACK + status report required
body:
Master PM is the routing authority on .agent-comms (do not fork/duplicate the bus).

REQUIRED ACTIONS (ack this message):
1) ACK prior messages requiring ack: System Online (c711cb43...) and Status request (ca2aedb6...).
2) Heartbeat with accurate status (IN_PROGRESS|IDLE|BLOCKED).
3) Reply on thread ca2aedb6 with: status, tip commit, blockers, locks needed, next milestone, READY_FOR_INTEGRATION yes/no.
4) CRM: do NOT interrupt Maker OA / smoke / auth. Report only.
5) Operations: STOP further edits to locked shared indexes (_index.json, command-center-views.json); file lock request if still needed.
6) Executive: hold READY FOR INTEGRATION; no shared-file writes.
7) Portal/AI: commit WIP on your branch; stay exclusive.
8) Finance: start exclusive scaffold only.
9) Escalate DECISION types only for owner gates (Prod, merge, consent, licenses, sharing).

Owner decisions already escalated offline: D-001 Maker connector consent; D-002 CRM canvas Maker build.
